characters.name: Vicky
characters.desc: Sanjauli ka ladka, Government College mein pehla saal. Baap ki garage abhi bhi chalti hai, par Vicky ka raasta ab college ke gate se hokar jaata hai.

characters.name: Amma
characters.desc: Vicky ki maa. Sanjauli ki teen-manzila ke upar wale kamre mein. Sach sabse pehle wahi bolti hai.

characters.name: Chhotu
characters.desc: Jakhoo ki chadhai pe rehta hai. Bandaron se baat karta hai, aur poore Mall pe nazar rakhta hai.

characters.name: Rahgeer
characters.desc: Sadak par chalta koi aam aadmi. Naam nahi, par zubaan teekhi.

characters.name: Dukandaar
characters.desc: Bazaar ka dukandaar. Apni dukan ke aage koi panga nahi chalta.

characters.name: Deepika
characters.desc: Vicky ki classmate. Notes bhi deti hai aur seedhi baat bhi.

characters.name: Thakur Sir
characters.desc: Political Science ke HOD. Har batch mein ek ladke ko pehchaan lete hain.

characters.name: Sameer
characters.desc: Teesre saal ka chhatra neta. Union uske baap ka samajhta hai.

characters.name: Netaji
characters.desc: Zile ka purana neta. Ladko ko pehchanta hai, istemaal bhi karta hai.

characters.name: Baudi wali
characters.desc: Sanjauli ki sabse purani kahani. Koi maanta nahi, koi raat ko wahan jaata bhi nahi.
